prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: third high-fidelity compositional option for the desktop landing page of “3DCreativeLab”, 1440×900 landscape, edge to edge, no browser frame or device.
Product and job: Colombian 3D-printing store; a visitor should understand professional fabrication, compare available objects and open the catalog or WhatsApp.
Visible Spanish content: “Del archivo al objeto”, “Imprimimos piezas con acabado profesional, disponibles o hechas bajo pedido.”, CTA “Explorar catálogo”, three honest demo products “Maceta facetada”, “Soporte para audífonos”, “Dinosaurio articulado”, prices in COP, statuses “Disponible” and “Bajo pedido”, navigation “Productos”, “Personalizados”, “Cómo fabricamos”, “WhatsApp”.
Concept: catalog-led variation of the approved production-traveler world. One continuous full-width production sheet moves horizontally across the first viewport: the large offer occupies its left third, while three real-looking matte 3D-printed objects sit on adjacent inspection stations inside the same sheet. Selecting a station would expose price, stock and fabrication time. The first station is active in signal red; the others are black and white. The beginning of a custom-request section appears below as a large red field.
Visual law: only vivid signal red, true black and white. Bold utilitarian sans display, readable body, precise registration lines and status stamps only when informative. Clean workshop stock and filament texture, not vintage paper.
One dominant continuous-inspection-line move; surrounding navigation and copy remain calm and unmistakably usable.
Constraints: no cream, green, blue, gradients, glass, floating pill nav, icon-card row, fake reviews, discounts, statistics, lorem ipsum, browser chrome or mockup device.
